Trust decision: a principal may make the datasource proxy attach a secret only if it holds read on that secret's scope (Secret in the datasource's project, GlobalSecret globally), enforced both where a datasource spec is saved (both Create/Update services) and where an unsaved spec is proxied (`fix.diff:206,266,336,394`; `internal/api/impl/proxy/projectdatasource.go:47`).
`pattern_fit`: A+B — the fix spans proxy handlers plus a second datasource write path in another package, and dashboard-embedded datasources reach the same sink with no secret check.
Strongest lever: dashboard Create/Update stores an attacker-chosen URL + secret name (`internal/api/impl/v1/dashboard/service.go:57-85`), then the saved dashboard-datasource proxy route (`localdatasource.go:62-77`) discloses the secret — the fix never touches the dashboard save path.
Biggest red flag: none of the defined flags held (no tests in the fix, one commit, multi-site); recall risk medium and repo size unverified since no shell was available.
